thread:
Evelyn (CS): Heads-up: Thread for HelixRetail's Dedicated bring-up. Forecasted promo next Thu looks like ~34% over committed quota during 10:00-12:00 ET. Need quick plan: autoscale guardrail, provisional burst, a ~25m load validation, and rollback steps. Who can take what?

Marco (Eng): I'll own autoscale + fallback policy. Suggest trigger when p95 > 260ms, cap burst at +35%, fallback to quantized-small. Will PR config to infra repo.

Hani (Infra): I can stand up provisional burst slots once billing signs off. Need quota token and exact window. Zone affinity could push some slots to us-east-1b.

Evelyn (CS): Quota token = HELIX-2026-Q1. Window Thu 10:00-12:00 ET (prep 09:30). Looping in @billing. Renewal team: please hold auto-renew flag until we validate capacity. Renewal risk = medium if we can't show headroom.

Vera (SRE): I'll draft a compact runbook with prechecks and rollback. Rollback steps: shift traffic off Dedicated pool, disable autoscale ramp, and if needed failover to hosted. I'll add a quick chaos probe to test fallback.

Luis (PDE): I'll run a 25m soak at 10:15 ET. Load profile: peak 7k RPS, 55% long-gen, 45% short. Using loadgen: 
```bash
./loadgen --target https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate --rps 7000 --duration 1500 --profile profiles/helix-mix.json --auth "Bearer $HELIX_TOKEN"
```
I'll collect latency histograms, 5xx counts, and KV cache hit-sampler. Will post artifacts.

Marco (Eng): Draft autoscale yaml will include alerts on 5xx-rate and queue-depth. Plan: cool_down 90s, scale_down threshold 140ms. I'll tag @Hani and @Vera in the PR for validation.

ops-bot: Job created -> load-helix-1758001400. Link: https://ci.internal/steps/lt-helix-1758001400 :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Hani (Infra): Billing approved provisional burst Thu 09:30-12:30 ET. I'll provision and post slot IDs today. Note that some slots may be in us-east-1b.

Vera (SRE): Runbook draft: https://confluence.internal/helix/dedicated-bringup. Adding rollback snippet now:
```bash
# route back to default pool
redwood route update --customer helix --pool default
# disable autoscale ramp
redwood autoscale update --customer helix --enabled false
```
I'll add pager rotations and healthcheck commands.

Evelyn (CS): Action recap: Marco -> autoscale PR + fallback (EOD); Hani -> provision slots + IDs (EOD); Luis -> load run Thu 10:15 ET and post results; Vera -> finalize runbook & chaos probe (Wed EOD); Evelyn -> customer comms and renewal hold. Reconvene Wed 16:30 ET for go/no-go.

Marco (Eng): Acknowledged. I'll include cost estimate for the window and an owner for the cost alert.

Luis (PDE): Will share artifacts here after shadow/staging run. Including sample failing payloads for triage.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled -> load-helix job 1758001400 will start in 24h.

Evelyn (CS): Final note: log any anomalies to ticket HELIX-9001 and escalate to #incidents if 5xx spikes or p95 breaches SLA.
